headline: Alphabet Market Value Drops $500 Billion Amid Search Advertising Pressures
summary: Google parent Alphabet lost over $500 billion in market capitalization after its shares fell 13% due to artificial intelligence pressures on search advertising.
why: Alphabet is one of the world's largest digital advertising and technology companies, serving as a bellwether for internet economy trends.

impacts.name: Alphabet Inc.
impacts.why: Concerns over AI competition impacting search ad revenues led to a sharp stock selloff.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A 13% share plunge triggered by concerns over search ad performance under AI pressures erased over $500 billion in market value.
